name: L-theanine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A non-proteinogenic amino acid found in tea leaves, marketed as a dietary supplement and typically taken with caffeine for its reported effect on subjective calm.

systems.note: Taken for its effect on subjective calm and attention; the intended effect.

monitors.why: The accessible instrument for the affective effect claimed.
